title: Schwarzschild exterior in curvature coordinates

coordinate_system.name: Schwarzschild curvature coordinates
coordinate_system.description: A static spherical chart restricted to the exterior region r > 2M in geometrized units.

excluded_sets: theta = 0 and theta = pi spherical-coordinate axis degeneracy
domain.chart_coverage: Exterior curvature-coordinate patch only; no claim about a horizon-penetrating or maximal extension.

conventions.riemann_tensor_definition: R^rho_{sigma mu nu} = d_mu Gamma^rho_{nu sigma} - d_nu Gamma^rho_{mu sigma} + Gamma^rho_{mu lambda} Gamma^lambda_{nu sigma} - Gamma^rho_{nu lambda} Gamma^lambda_{mu sigma}

assumptions: The benchmark is classical general relativity in four dimensions with zero cosmological constant.
The evaluated chart is restricted to the static exterior domain r > 2M.
The source mass lies outside the evaluated vacuum domain; T_mu_nu is zero throughout the submitted chart.
This established solution is a tensor-engine calibration benchmark, not a transportation proposal or novel geometry.

claims.statement: Within the declared exterior domain, the submitted metric is the Schwarzschild vacuum solution under the declared tensor conventions.

falsification: Reject if the metric differs from the preregistered Schwarzschild exterior components.
Reject if the candidate admits r <= 2M or M <= 0 inside the evaluated chart.
Reject if any preregistered Christoffel or representative Riemann component differs after symbolic simplification.
Reject vacuum status if any Ricci, Ricci-scalar, or Einstein-tensor component is nonzero.
Reject the curvature invariant if the Kretschmann scalar is not exactly 48*M**2/r**6.
Downgrade comparison status if the separate EinsteinPy solver path does not match.

references.title: On the Gravitational Field of a Mass Point According to Einstein's Theory
